top_signals.title: UK jobs seekers rise despite recovery in permanent hiring
top_signals.summary: Rising redundancies and heightened employment insecurity drove a sharp increase in UK job seekers in August despite the permanent hiring market showing its first signs of recovery in nearly four years. Total staff availability rose at its fastest rate in three months as Brits hunting for roles flooded the market. This influx was triggered by [...]
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
